Workqueue was lacking a mechanism to modify the timeout of an already
pending delayed_work.  delayed_work users have been working around
this using several methods - using an explicit timer + work item

column2: all of which are error-prone and/or ugly.

column1: This patch implements mod_delayed_work[_on]() which behaves similarly
to mod_timer() - if the delayed_work is idle

column2: its timeout is modified to the new value.
